description: This file defines the Transaction entity class for the banking application, representing account transactions with properties such as amount, type, description, and creation timestamp. It maps to the 'transactions' table in the database and uses JPA, Hibernate, Lombok, and Jakarta Validation annotations.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a financial transaction linked to an account, with properties such as amount, type, description, and timestamp, including JPA annotations for ORM mapping and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Pre-persist lifecycle callback that sets the createdAt timestamp to the current time if it is not already set.
